notes: Put away heads on the verb because away is a bare phrasal particle naming nothing, matching the corpus reading of sur as take away; put far heads on far, which carries rachaq's lexeme, and the competing reading treating far as a particle is named in the unit note (rule 44).

a wayward mouth: the chain is rendered attributively with the construct noun standing before the rectum's word, so the single supplied determiner is the construct noun's (rules 28, 29); the parallel chain has no determiner written.
